🏡 OUR HUMBLE BEGINNING

Fathy's Kitchen Beginning

Fathy's Kitchen began humbly out of a shared passion for bringing families back together around the dinner table, starting from a small home kitchen where traditional family recipes were lovingly prepared from scratch. What initially began as a way to share comforting, home-cooked meals with neighbors and close friends quickly blossomed into a local favorite for event catering. Built on the belief that nothing beats the warmth and rich flavors of a meal made with care, Fathy's Kitchen specializes in taking the stress out of gatherings by providing freshly cooked, hearty dishes tailored for birthdays, family reunions, and community celebrations.

                      🐬 XAMPP APACHE + MYSQL + PHPMYADMIN
                      
XAMPP MySQL Database (fathys_kitchen_db) & phpMyAdmin

                      

                        Automatically connects to http://localhost/fathys_kitchen/api.php (MySQL root@localhost:3306) when running in XAMPP, and mirrors all SQL tables live below!
                      

                    

                    

                      
                      
                      
                    

                  


                  
                  

                    

                      

                        🗄️ phpMyAdmin Table Browser (fathys_kitchen_db):
                      

                      

                        
                        
                        
                        
                      

                    

                    

                      SELECT * FROM `menu_inventory` ORDER BY `id` ASC;
                    

                    

                      

                        
                        
                      

                    

                  


                  

                    

                      1️⃣ Start XAMPP Control Panel
                      
Start Apache and MySQL in XAMPP Control Panel.

                    

                    

                      2️⃣ Import in phpMyAdmin
                      
Open http://localhost/phpmyadmin, click Import, and upload fathys_kitchen_db.sql.

                    

                    

                      3️⃣ Place in htdocs
                      
Put this HTML file and api.php inside C:\\xampp\\htdocs\\fathys_kitchen\\.
